home_title: One familiar place. Every Remy app.
home_description: A shared foundation for Remy, in your language.
home_intro: The same controls, colours and language follow you from one Remy app to the next.
demo_description: Try a small interaction using the same shared controls.
demo_note: This is a public demo. Account and sign-in features are coming next.
not_found_detail: This page is unavailable. Return to the overview.
zone_description: The name, UTC offset and local time of a time zone, in your language.
zone_intro: Every time zone has a name, an offset from UTC and a local time, each written by your language’s own rules.
zone_not_found: There is no time zone called {zone}.
formats_description: How Remy adapts dates, times, calendars, numbers, currency, plurals and sorting to your language.
formats_intro: Every value below comes from the shared message catalog and your language's own rules, rendered the same way on the server and in the browser.
currency_note: Each app owns its money: store integer minor units with an ISO 4217 code and format them with this catalog.
choices_note: Your choices live in the address, so a link to this page shows the same values.

declarations: local formatted = instant: datetime dateStyle=full timeStyle=long timeZone=UTC
local formatted = date: datetime dateStyle=long timeZone=UTC
local formatted = days: relativetime unit=day numeric=auto
local formatted = amount: number style=currency currency=EUR

guests_invalid: Enter a whole number of seats from 1 to 20.
leave_unsaved: Leave this page? Your reservation has not been made yet.

declarations: local formatted = km: number style=unit unit=kilometer unitDisplay=long

local_time_note: This row is rendered in your browser: the server never sees your device's clock, so it uses Cloudflare's location instead.
location_note: Cloudflare reports the network's location with each request; the server uses it for the local time above and does not store it.
live_status_note: Rendered on the server, then refreshed by your browser while this page is open.
live_status_note_browser: Asked of another service by your browser, and refreshed while this page is open.
language_hint: This page is also available in {language}.
device_place_note: Your browser can share where this device is. It stays on this page: nothing is sent to our servers.
device_place_denied: Your browser did not share a location.
device_place_unavailable: Your device could not find its location.
device_place_unsupported: This browser cannot share a location.
app_home_description: The interactive side of Remy: live data, forms and your device.
app_home_intro: Everything here runs in your browser. The site pages stay readable without JavaScript.
location_description: Your network location from Cloudflare and, if you allow it, your device’s own.
location_intro: Compare what the network says with what your device says.
section_language_note: Which language this is, how it is written and read.
section_time_note: What day and time it is, and how this language writes them.
section_numbers_note: How numbers are written: digits, grouping, percentages and units.
section_money_note: How amounts look, in this language and in other currencies.
section_words_note: How text changes with a value: plurals, order, variants and sorting.
words_label: Words in the home page title
ask_hint: A short answer with links to the pages it comes from. Up to {max} characters.
ask_description: Short answers from the Remy documentation, with links to the exact sections.
ask_intro: Ask a question about Remy. The answer cites the documentation sections it comes from; follow the links to read them in full.
ask_too_long: Your question is {length} characters long. Keep it to {max} characters.
ask_rate_limited: Too many questions from your connection. Wait a minute, then ask again.
ask_no_answer: No answer this time. Search the documentation instead.
search_description: Find a page or section of the Remy documentation.
search_none_hint: Try other words, or browse the pages listed here.
clock_description: The time now in the time zones you choose.
clock_intro: The time now where you are and in the zones you add, written the way your language writes it.
settings_description: Your language, the app's appearance, and what this device tells the app.
settings_intro: Your language and the app's appearance, kept on this device, and what the device tells the app.
settings_language_hint: Every page, the dates and the numbers follow it.
account_description: Signing in to Remy, once the auth service is ready.
account_intro: Your sign-in and your sessions will be here.
account_empty_description: Signing in arrives with Remy's auth service. Until then the app stores nothing about you.
home_shared_intro: Remy apps are built on one package, @joeblew999/remy-ui, so each starts from the same pieces.
home_shared_components_text: Stock shadcn components and theme, the same in every app.
home_shared_languages_text: Paraglide message catalogs in {count} languages, and each language's own rules for dates, numbers, plurals and reading direction.
home_shared_pages_text: Site pages work without JavaScript and are made for search engines; app pages live under /app and run in your browser.
home_shared_checks_text: The same browser checks run against every app built on the package.
home_guide_text: For people using the app: what each page does, in your language.
home_developers_text: For developers building Remy or an app on it, and its API reference.
